meta.name: The Search For Truth In Wartime
meta.description: The Search For Truth In Wartimeinvestigates the changing face of war reporting and the role of the media during wartime, in context with the Crimea through the two World Wars, to Vietnam and the Falklands. “What is the role of the media in wartime? Is it simply to record, or is it to explain? And from whose point of view–the military, the politicians or the victims?”
